resources.string: Written into exported photos (EXIF and XMP) unless the export\'s metadata is set to None.
Next to each edited photo, in folders Reveal can write to. Lightroom and darktable read the basic settings.
An edit from another device or from Lightroom becomes one step you can undo.
Allowed: photos shared from the gallery stay readable
Off: photos shared from the gallery are readable while Reveal is open
Keep your edits, versions, ratings and flags on every device, with your own Reveal sync server. Nothing goes to anyone else\'s cloud.
On the server\'s setup page, open Devices, then Pair a device, and scan the code or paste its link here.
Point the camera at the QR code on the server\'s setup page.
Reveal needs the camera only to read the pairing code. You can paste the link instead.
This is not a Reveal pairing link. Copy it again from the server\'s setup page.
The pairing code was already used or has expired (codes last 10 minutes). Show a new one on the server.
The link answers as a different server than the one in the code. Check the server address.
The server did not answer. Check that this device can reach its address.
The server could not pair this device. Try again in a moment.
The server cannot be reached. Changes wait here and go up when it can.
The server no longer knows this device (it was removed). Unpair and pair again.
The address now answers as a different server. Unpair and pair with the new one.
The server has no backup folder yet: previews and originals wait. Edits still sync.
The server reported an error. Sync tries again later.
Edits with their history, versions, ratings, flags, labels and your export author always sync.
A developable copy (about 2560 px, a few MB) of edited photos whose original cannot reach the server, so your other devices can keep editing them. Ratings, flags and labels sync without one.
Photos only this device has are uploaded once: the photos you edit, and every photo of a folder set to “Everything”. Photos the server already has, such as its NAS folders, never are.
Each folder backs up the originals of the photos you edit; switch one on to back up all its photos. Switching to “Only photos you edit” never deletes originals already on the server.
Everything: every photo the server does not have yet
Reveal forgets the server on this device: its key, and the photos only the server has. Your edits stay here and on the server.
This server is reached over plain HTTP: use that address only on your home network or Tailscale, and HTTPS (a tunnel or a reverse proxy) anywhere else.
Thumbnails, previews, edits; clear the cache

Reveal never copies or moves your photos: originals stay where they are (camera card, gallery, folders, network shares). Reveal stores only thumbnails, previews and your edits (recipes), plus parts of server originals while you view them. Edited photos are backed up to your server when you are paired.
Grid and filmstrip pictures, made again when needed
Parts of originals and previews from your server, kept while you view them
Previews of photos other apps shared with Reveal
%1$s of them are a photo\'s only copy and stay
Masks and Remove fills, made again when needed
Exports in progress, shared files, previews being sent to your server
Your edits, ratings and the library. Never cleared.
Thumbnails and server files stay under this size together; the least recently used go first.
Frees thumbnails, server files and other cached files. Never your edits, never the library, never a preview that is a photo\'s only copy.
Thumbnails and previews are made again when you open the library or a photo, and server files are read again from your server. Your photos and edits are not touched.
